chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, from Al-Qāsim ibn Sulaymān, from Abī Maryam Al-Anṣārī, who said:

I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a boy who has not yet had a wet dream, and who slanders a man: is he to be flogged? He said: “No. And that is because if a man were to slander the boy, he would not be flogged.”

key_terms.اَلْغُلَامِ: a boy who has not yet reached full legal maturity
key_terms.لَمْ يَحْتَلِمْ: has not yet experienced puberty through a wet dream
key_terms.يَقْذِفُ: accuses or slanders someone with an imputing allegation
key_terms.يُجْلَدُ: is subjected to flogging as a legal hadd punishment

ai.seo_question: Is a prepubescent boy flogged for slander in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the hadd punishment for slander. It states that a boy who has not reached puberty is not subjected to flogging for qadhf, and the reasoning given is that slandering such a boy likewise does not incur the hadd punishment.
